analysis: Frame 7 of the data set (single-storey two-bay frame with a diagonal brace and a lean-on column), units kip and inch. Plane frame in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held (the data set's frames are 'fully braced out-of-plane'); in-plane bending about local z, so the data set's Izz is the section's Iz. Modulus 0.8 E = 23200 ksi (the data set's condition for all elastic analyses; its element table points to E = 29000 ksi, the published results correspond to 0.8 E - verified for this frame with the first-order displacements). No shear deformation. A straight line of the data set's elements is one member here, the loads at its interior nodes are point loads on the member. The data set's model is plane (no out-of-plane buckling of a member between joints); the engine's member is spatial, so Iy = 1000 Izz is entered for every section instead of the listed Iyy: no out-of-plane mode can precede the in-plane behaviour compared, and Iy does not enter the in-plane results. Case 'Right' of the data set: imperfect geometry with every node at x + y/500, lateral loads acting toward +x. Second-order elastic analysis, compared with the data set's 'WC' results: MASTAN2, work-control incremental analysis with step size 0.001, updated Lagrangian formulation with geometric stiffness matrices, 4 elements per member (article, Tables 2 and 3). The engine solves the small-displacement second-order theory with exact member stability functions (docs/THEORY.md 10, 12).

quarantine.diagnosis: The engine produces no results: it refuses the combination as beyond the elastic critical load (buckling factor about 0.85). Cause: in the case 'Right' the only diagonal brace (one pin-ended element, W4x13, 375 in long) is in compression: first-order force 21.68 kip against its Euler load pi^2 (0.8 E) I / L^2 = 18.45 kip (ratio 1.18; verification/derive/ziemian_diagnosis.py). The engine's pin-ended member is a beam-column that buckles at its Euler load; the data set's single pin-ended element has no member buckling (the data set reports displacements 2.340 and 2.342 in for this case). The description file of the data set states that only the tension brace is modelled, i.e. the frame is meant for the case 'Left'. Not usable as a target for this engine.
